camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeActiveOperationTasks --region cn-hangzhou --Status 3 --AllowCancel 1 --PageSize 25 --PageNumber 1 --AllowChange='-1' --TaskType rds_apsradb_transfer --Region 'cn-shanghai' --ProductId Redis --InsName 'r-wz96fzmpvpr2qnqnlb' --DbType redis --ChangeLevel all
description_en: Queries the O\\\\\&M event details of an instance
description_zh: 查询实例的运维事件详情
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-active-operation-tasks --biz-region cn-shanghai --task-type rds_apsradb_transfer --page-size 25 --page-number 1 --product-id Redis --db-type redis --status 3 --ins-name r-wz96fzmpvpr2qnqnlb --allow-change='-1' --allow-cancel 1 --change-level all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationTasks

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the O&M task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list.

A value of all indicates all region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
待处理事件所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html接口获取。
取值为all表示所有地域ID
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The type of the O\&M event. If this parameter is not specified, all types of O\&M events are queried.

Valid values:

rds_apsradb_upgrade: minor version update
rds_apsaradb_ha: primary/secondary switchover
rds_apsaradb_ssl_update: SSL certificate update
rds_apsaradb_major_upgrade: major version upgrade
rds_apsradb_transfer: instance migration
rds_apsaradb_modify_config: network upgrade
rds_apsaradb_modify_config: instance parameter adjustment
rds_apsaradb_maxscale: proxy minor version update
parameters.help_zh: 运维事件类型，如果为空则查询所有类型
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 25. Maximum value: 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The name of the service. Valid values: RDS, POLARDB, MongoDB, and Redis. For Redis instances, set the value to Redis
parameters.help_zh: 产品名称, RDS/POLARDB/MongoDB/Redis，对于 Redis 实例可选 Redis
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The database type. Valid values: redis
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of an O\&M event. This parameter is used to filter returned tasks. Valid values:

-1: filters all events.
3: filters pending events.
4: filters in-progress events.
5: filters successful events.
6: filters failed events.
7: filters canceled events
parameters.help_zh:
运维事件状态，用于筛选返回任务，取值：
-1：全部事件。
3：待处理事件。
4：处理中事件。
5：成功结束事件。
6：失败结束事件。
7：已取消事件
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance. You can leave this parameter empty. If you configure this parameter, you can specify the name only of one instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例名，可不填，填写时只允许填写至多一个实例名
parameters.name: ins_name

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition that is used to return events based on the settings of the switching time. Default value: -1. Valid values:

-1: returns all events.
0: returns only O\&M events for which the switching time cannot be changed.
-1: returns only O\&M events for which the switching time can be changed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许修改时间，默认-1，取值：

-1：全部。
0：只返回不允许修改时间的运维事件。
1：只返回允许修改时间的运维事件
parameters.name: allow_change

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition that is used to return events based on the settings of event cancellation. Default value: -1. Valid values:

-1: returns all events.
0: returns only O\&M events that cannot be canceled.
1: returns only O\&M events that can be canceled
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许取消，默认-1，取值：

-1：全部。
0：只返回不允许取消的运维事件。
1：只返回允许取消的运维事件
parameters.name: allow_cancel

parameters.help_en:
The type of task configuration change. Valid values:

all (default): The configurations of all O\&M tasks are changed.
S0: The configurations of tasks initiated to fix exceptions are changed.
S1: The configurations of system O\&M tasks are changed
parameters.help_zh:
变更级别，默认all：

all：选择全部异常修复和系统运维的级别
S0：异常修复
S1：系统运维
parameters.name: change_level

AllowCancel.description_en: Indicates whether the event can be canceled. The value 1 indicates that the event can be canceled. The value 0 indicates that the event cannot be canceled
AllowCancel.description_zh: 是否允许取消，1 表示允许用户取消事件，0 表示不允许取消

AllowChange.description_en: Indicates whether the switching time can be changed. The value 1 indicates that the switching time can be changed. The value 0 indicates that the switching time cannot be changed
AllowChange.description_zh: 是否允许修改时间，1 表示允许用户修改时间，0 表示不允许用户修改时间

ChangeLevel.description_en: The code of the task level. The value S1 indicates the system O\&M level. The value S0 indicates the exception fixing level
ChangeLevel.description_zh: 事件等级代码，S1 系统运维 S0 风险修复

ChangeLevelEn.description_en: The level of the task in English

ChangeLevelZh.description_en: The level of the task in Chinese

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

DbType.description_en: The database type of the instance. The return value is Redis

DbVersion.description_en: The version of the database engine

Deadline.description_en: The deadline before which the time to preform the O&M task can be modified. The time in UTC is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
Deadline.description_zh: 任务执行时间可调整范围的最晚期限，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Id.description_en: The ID of the O\&M event

ImpactEn.description_en: The impact of the task in English

ImpactZh.description_en: The impact of the task in Chinese

InsComment.description_en: The alias and description of the instance

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M task was modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

PrepareInterval.description_en: The required preparation period between the task start time and the switchover time. The time is displayed in the HH:mm:ss format
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 开始时间到切换时间之间所需的准备时间, 格式为 HH:mm:ss

Region.description_en: The region ID of the instance

ResultInfo.description_en: The information about the execution result

StartTime.description_en: The time when the event is executed in the backend. The time must be in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
StartTime.description_zh: 后台执行事件的时间点，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Status.description_en:
The status of the O\&M event. Valid values:

3: filters pending events.
4: filters in-progress events.
5: filters successful events.
6: filters failed events.
7: filters canceled events
Status.description_zh:
运维事件状态，返回值：
3：待处理事件。
4：处理中事件。
5：成功结束事件。
6：失败结束事件。
7：已取消事件

SwitchTime.description_en: The time when the system performs the switchover operation. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
SwitchTime.description_zh: 后台发起切换操作的时间点，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

TaskType.description_en: The type of the O\&M event

TaskTypeEn.description_en: The cause of the O\&M event
TaskTypeEn.description_zh: 产生运维事件原因英文

TaskTypeZh.description_en: The reason for the task in Chinese

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Default 25

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The number of O\&M events returned
